description:
Penthouse 16 Hazelbrook is an exceptional three-bedroom penthouse residence offering an outstanding combination of luxurious internal accommodation and remarkable outdoor living space.

Penthouse 16 Hazelbrook is an exceptional three-bedroom penthouse residence extending to approximately 244 sq.m. (2,626 sq.ft.), offering an outstanding combination of luxurious internal accommodation and remarkable outdoor living space. Occupying a prime position within this highly regarded development, the property is surrounded by an expansive private terrace that wraps around the apartment, creating a truly unique setting for entertaining, relaxing and enjoying panoramic views. 

The accommodation has been thoughtfully designed with generously proportioned rooms throughout. At the heart of the home lies the impressive living and dining room, an elegant and light-filled space extending over 14 metres in length. Large windows and multiple access points ensure a seamless connection to the exceptional terrace, allowing natural light to flood the interior while providing an ideal setting for indoor-outdoor living. 

The kitchen is exceptionally spacious and well equipped, featuring an extensive range of contemporary units, quality worktops and integrated appliances. A separate pantry, utility room and adjoining gym offer an abundance of practical and versatile living space rarely found in apartment living. 

The bedroom accommodation is equally impressive. The principal suite is a luxurious retreat, complete with a generous walk-in wardrobe, a stylish ensuite bathroom and direct access to the terrace. A second spacious double bedroom also benefits from its own ensuite bathroom, while the third bedroom offers excellent flexibility for family living, guests or home working. A separate study provides an ideal private workspace, further enhancing the versatility of the accommodation. A guest WC and ample storage complete this exceptional penthouse. 

One of the defining features of Penthouse 16 Hazelbrook is its extraordinary private terrace. Extending around much of the residence and accessed from a number of rooms, this remarkable outdoor space provides endless opportunities for al fresco dining, entertaining or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Rarely does a penthouse offer such an extensive outdoor amenity, effectively creating a private rooftop garden in the heart of South Dublin. 

Hazelbrook is a highly sought-after development, enjoying a peaceful and mature setting while being exceptionally well positioned for all the amenities of South Dublin. A pedestrian gate to the rear of the development provides direct access to Drummartin Road, with the Kilmacud Luas stop just a short stroll away. Dundrum Village, Dundrum Town Centre, Stillorgan and Sandyford are all within easy reach, offering an unparalleled range of shopping, dining, leisure and entertainment facilities. 

With its substantial proportions, outstanding penthouse layout, exceptional wraparound terrace and superb location, Penthouse 16 Hazelbrook represents a rare opportunity to acquire one of South Dublin's most impressive and distinctive apartment homes. 

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the scale, quality and unique outdoor living space on offer.
